Changelog
*********


Python seguinte
===============

*Data de lançamento: XXXX-XX-XX*


Segurança
---------

* gh-160499: Fix unbounded memory growth in "asyncio" TLS connections
  when a peer stops reading but keeps sending records that make
  OpenSSL generate its own replies (such as TLS 1.2 renegotiation
  alerts).  Reading from the peer is now paused when this output
  accumulates, instead of only when application data does.

* gh-160506: Fix "os.path.realpath()" on Windows returning the wrong
  path for a broken relative symbolic link reached through a symbolic
  link to a directory. This allowed "tarfile" extraction with the
  "'data'" or "'tar'" filter to create a file outside the destination
  directory.

* gh-160420: Fix "zoneinfo.ZoneInfo" on Windows accepting keys in
  which a component after a "/" starts with a drive letter, such as
  "America/C:\file".  Such a key could open a file outside the
  "tzdata" package; it now raises "ValueError".


Núcleo e embutidos
------------------

* gh-160773: Fix a crash in "str()" of an "OSError" when formatting
  one of its attributes modifies the others.

* gh-159652: Fix a hang when an import fails with "RecursionError"
  because the C stack is nearly exhausted: releasing the import locks
  could itself fail and leave the global import lock or a module lock
  held forever, so that later imports in other threads blocked
  indefinitely. The import system now raises "RecursionError" before
  taking an import lock when there is not enough stack left to release
  it.

* gh-159136: Setting "__name__", "__qualname__", "__doc__" or
  "__module__" on a function no longer stops all threads in the free-
  threaded build. This fixes a large slowdown in multi-threaded code
  using "functools.wraps()" since 3.14.7.

* gh-152631: Fix "ast.parse()" ability to parse lazy imports with
  *feature_version* older than 3.15, now it properly raises
  "SyntaxError".


Biblioteca
----------

* gh-137549: "asyncio.timeout()" now inserts "TimeoutError" into the
  context chain of sub-exceptions of a "BaseExceptionGroup", as it
  already did for "ExceptionGroup".

* gh-53089: "urllib.request.HTTPDigestAuthHandler" now sends "uri="/""
  in the Digest "Authorization" header for URLs with an empty path,
  such as "http://example.com", matching the request-target sent by
  "http.client". Previously it sent "uri=""", which servers could
  reject. Patch by Senthil Kumaran.

* gh-109564: Fix a race in "asyncio" where closing a server after it
  accepted a connection, but before the connection's transport was
  created, reported an "AssertionError" to the exception handler. Such
  connections are now closed quietly.

* gh-53852: "urllib.request.ProxyDigestAuthHandler" now raises
  "HTTPError" with status code 407 (Proxy Authentication Required)
  instead of 401 when proxy authentication fails.

* gh-160806: Fix the pure-Python implementation of
  "datetime.timedelta" losing sub-second precision with large float
  arguments. It now gives the same results as the C implementation.

* gh-160781: Fix "io.BytesIO" implementation of "io.IOBase.truncate()"
  rejecting sizes larger than "2**31 - 1" on Windows.

* gh-160781: Fix "io.StringIO" implementation of
  "io.IOBase.truncate()" rejecting sizes larger than "2**31 - 1" on
  Windows.

* gh-160781: Fix "io.BytesIO" raising "SystemError" instead of
  "OverflowError" when writing at a position close to "sys.maxsize".

* gh-160596: Fix the error message for invalid data passed to
  "asyncio.proactor_events.sendto()".

* gh-160561: Fix a descriptor leak in "socket.fromfd()" when the
  socket constructor rejects its arguments. The duplicated descriptor
  was never closed.

* gh-60299: Fix "urllib.request.ProxyDigestAuthHandler" failing to
  authenticate. It looked up credentials using the target request URL
  instead of the proxy's authority, so passwords registered via
  "add_password()" against the proxy never matched. Patch by Senthil
  Kumaran.

* gh-160314: Raise an error in "lzma.LZMAFile", "lzma.decompress()",
  "bz2.BZ2File" and "bz2.decompress()" for a damaged ".xz" or bzip2
  stream that follows another stream, instead of silently ignoring it
  and everything after it as trailing data.

* gh-159739: Fix HZ encoding of a tilde at an output buffer boundary
  and ISO-2022 decoding of split escape sequences. Reset ISO-2022
  incremental codecs to their initial state. Keep multibyte codec
  tables and custom encoder error policies alive when Python code
  replaces them during use.

* gh-160310: Fix quadratic time complexity of "gzip.decompress()",
  "bz2.decompress()", "lzma.decompress()" and
  "compression.zstd.decompress()" on data consisting of many
  concatenated members.

* gh-160522: Fix the incremental encoders and stream writers of the
  stateful CJK codecs ("iso2022_*" and "hz") keeping a changed shift
  state after an "encode()" or "write()" call failed.  The next call
  could omit the escape sequence, writing multibyte characters in
  ASCII mode.

* gh-160518: Fix the "hz" codec sometimes encoding "~" as a single "~"
  instead of "~~" in text that mixes ASCII and Chinese characters,
  which produced data that did not decode back to the original text.

* gh-160513: Fix "asyncio.loop.start_tls()" and
  "asyncio.StreamWriter.start_tls()" not calling the protocol's
  "connection_lost()" when the connection is lost, the handshake times
  out or the call is cancelled during the TLS handshake.
  "asyncio.StreamWriter.wait_closed()" no longer waits forever after
  such a failure.

* gh-160297: Fix "tarfile.TarFile.extractall()" and
  "tarfile.TarFile.extract()" changing the mode, modification time and
  owner of a file outside the destination directory when a hard link
  member is extracted as a copy of a symbolic link member, for example
  with the "'tar'" filter.

* gh-161086: Fix the "gzip" command-line interface ignoring "gzip
  --fast" and "gzip --best" when compressing files given as arguments.

* gh-161094: Fix "zipfile.is_zipfile()" raising "ValueError" instead
  of returning "False" for a file-like object, such as "io.BytesIO",
  whose end of central directory record places the central directory
  before the start of the file.

* gh-161096: Fix "zoneinfo.ZoneInfo.from_file()" accepting TZif data
  with a negative or oversized abbreviation block, which could use
  hundreds of times the file size in memory; it now raises
  "ValueError". Abbreviation indexes above 127 now also give the
  correct time zone abbreviation.

* gh-160185: Fix "codecs.StreamWriter.reset()" of the stateful CJK
  codecs ("hz" and the "iso2022_*" family) not writing the sequence
  that returns the output to ASCII.  "seek(0)" of
  "codecs.StreamWriter", "codecs.StreamReaderWriter" and
  "codecs.StreamRecoder" now resets the writer before moving the
  stream position.

* gh-159398: Fix the sampling profiler crashing when a string read
  from the target process contains code points above "U+10FFFF".

* gh-158998: Fix "os.statx()" ignoring the *follow_symlinks* argument.

* gh-157928: Correctly detect and handle OSC sequences in PyREPL.

* gh-157856: Fix "asyncio.as_completed()" raising "RuntimeError" ("no
  running event loop") when the iterator is created outside of a
  running event loop and driven with "loop.run_until_complete()".

* gh-151126: Fix a crash caused by failing to set "MemoryError" on
  allocation failure when first using a Chinese, Japanese or Korean
  codec.

* gh-139105: Correct the EOF key shown in the "sqlite3" CLI ".help"
  text on Windows.

* bpo-44170: Fix UnicodeDecodeError with multibyte utf8 characters in
  ShareableList.


Testes
------

* gh-158975: Replace fixed sleeps used for synchronization in
  multiprocessing tests with bounded waits to avoid failures on slow
  or overloaded systems.


Construção
----------

* gh-160704: Fix C11-C17 builds with old C library headers that do not
  define "static_assert", including glibc versions older than 2.16.


Python 3.15.2 final
===================

*Release date: 2026-10-25*


Segurança
---------

* gh-160300: Correge "http.cookiejar.DefaultCookiePolicy" que aceitava
  e retornava cookies com um atributo "Version" negativo, sem
  verificar se o domínio correspondia ao host da requisição. Tais
  cookies agora são ignorados.

* **CVE 2026-114583**, gh-160097: "tarfile.tar_filter()" agora rejeita
  membros do tipo link cujo caminho resulte no próprio diretório de
  destino, assim como "tarfile.data_filter()" já fazia.

* **CVE 2026-115557**, gh-160040: O módulo "ssl" agora rejeita cadeias
  de certificados TLS que contenham qualquer uma das chaves de
  autoridades certificadoras (CA) intermediárias da eMudhra que foram
  comprometidas. Esta é uma medida extraordinária e uma última linha
  de defesa: a remoção da confiança é, primordialmente, uma
  responsabilidade do repositório de certificados raiz da plataforma;
  a lista de bloqueio (denylist) embutida serve apenas para impedir
  conexões enquanto a atualização correspondente ainda não tiver
  chegado ao sistema operacional, a uma imagem de contêiner ou a um
  repositório de certificados incluído em diversos pacotes Python.
  Entradas são adicionadas a essa lista de bloqueio apenas sob
  critérios extremamente rigorosos. A verificação na lista de bloqueio
  baseia-se na chave pública (o hash SHA-256 do campo
  "SubjectPublicKeyInfo", conforme a **RFC 5280**), abrangendo,
  portanto, também certificados com assinatura cruzada (cross-signed)
  que reutilizam uma das chaves consideradas não confiáveis.


Núcleo e embutidos
------------------

* gh-160491: Corrige a localização informada para sequências de escape
  inválidas em f-strings e t-strings. O "SyntaxError" agora aponta
  para a parte literal que contém o escape, em vez de apontar para as
  aspas de fechamento.

* Corrige uma falha no módulo "tokenize" que ocorria quando um
  colchete de fechamento aparecia sem o correspondente de abertura
  logo após a chave de abertura de um campo de substituição em uma
  f-string ou t-string -- por exemplo, em "f'{]a'". Agora, o módulo
  emite o mesmo erro de falta de correspondência (unmatched) que o
  analisador sintático.

* gh-106045: Correção na descoberta de caminhos pelo módulo "venv"
  para casos em que o executável base aponta para um local fora da
  instalação indicada pela chave "home" no arquivo "pyvenv.cfg". A
  biblioteca padrão passa a ser localizada a partir de "home", e os
  módulos de extensão, a partir da instalação do executável resolvido,
  em vez de recorrer ao prefixo definido durante a compilação.

* gh-160162: Corrige uma falha em plataformas de 32 bits que ocorria
  ao realizar um deslocamento à esquerda (*left shift*) em um "int"
  por uma quantidade próxima a "sys.maxsize *
  sys.int_info.bits_per_digit". Agora, uma "OverflowError" é
  levantada, assim como ocorre para outras quantidades excessivamente
  grandes.

* gh-160179: Fix "bytearray.__init__()" leaving uninitialized memory
  in the object when it fails on a "list" or "tuple" containing an
  integer not in "range(256)". The object is now empty after the
  failed call.

* gh-159739: Fix a possible crash when assigning metadata to
  "classmethod" or "staticmethod" objects.

* gh-159739: Fix a race in "list.__sizeof__()" when a list is
  concurrently resized on a free-threaded build.

* gh-159739: Fix a reference leak when the value of a type alias is
  evaluated recursively or concurrently.

* gh-159739: Fix a crash in free-threaded builds when
  "codecs.unregister()" is called concurrently.

* gh-159963: Fix a regression in Python 3.15.0 where threads importing
  submodules of packages for the first time could raise
  "_DeadlockError" or a spurious "partially initialized module"
  "ImportError", or block one another, with no circular import
  involved. "importlib.import_module()" now returns the partially
  initialized module in a cross-thread circular import, as the
  "import" statement does, instead of raising "_DeadlockError".

* gh-159739: Fix reference leaks when free-threaded garbage collection
  aborts early because of an allocation error.

* gh-159739: Prevent free-threaded builds from interning and
  immortalizing complex subclasses in code object constants.

* gh-159739: Fix a reference leak in binary, ternary, and comparison
  operations on weak reference proxies when another operand is a dead
  proxy.

* gh-159739: Fix a crash when constructing an error for invalid
  generic alias arguments.

* gh-159739: Allow the garbage collector to break reference cycles
  involving property accessors or names.

* gh-159739: Fix a crash in "warnings.warn()" when
  "skip_file_prefixes" is an empty tuple subclass. Propagate
  allocation errors when creating the fallback filename.

* gh-159431: Fix an assertion failure, or an immortal object becoming
  mortal, on the *free threaded* build when an object passed to the
  internal delayed decref mechanism is immortal or becomes immortal
  before the delayed decref is processed by the garbage collector.

* gh-159294: Fix a crash in a debug build when creating an
  "ExceptionGroup" or "BaseExceptionGroup" fails with "MemoryError".
  Patch by Christian Aurich Zanettini Martins.

* gh-159244: Fix a crash in "dict" and "dict.update()" in the *free-
  threaded build* when another thread concurrently mutates a list used
  as a key/value pair. Patch by Christian Aurich Zanettini Martins.

* gh-159111: Update mimalloc version from 2.1.2 to 2.5.2. Patch by
  Donghee Na.

* gh-154318: Fix a crash when hashing a deeply nested "tuple" or
  "frozendict". A "RecursionError" is now raised instead of
  overflowing the C stack.

* gh-151818: Fix a double-free crash in "list.append()" (the
  specialized "CALL_LIST_APPEND" instruction) when growing the list
  fails with "MemoryError".


Biblioteca
----------

* gh-160549: Fix a crash when a "compression.zstd.ZstdCompressor" that
  uses worker threads and a "ZstdDict" is deallocated, or the
  interpreter exits, while data passed to "compress()" is still being
  compressed.

* gh-160535: Fix a crash in "compression.zstd" when the garbage
  collector frees a "ZstdCompressor" that uses worker threads together
  with its "ZstdDict" before the compression of already submitted data
  has finished.

* gh-160520: Fix "asyncio" SSL transports not applying
  *ssl_shutdown_timeout* when the peer has sent EOF but does not read
  the data still queued for it. Closing such a connection could wait
  indefinitely; it is now aborted with "TimeoutError" once the timeout
  expires.

* gh-160326: Raise "ValueError" for a NaN *timeout* in
  "threading.Condition.wait()" and the blocking calls built on it,
  such as "threading.Event.wait()", "threading.Semaphore.acquire()"
  and "queue.Queue.get()", instead of returning at once or looping
  without ever timing out.

* gh-159739: Fix crashes in "profiling.tracing" when a custom timer
  reinitializes the profiler or its result clears or disables the
  profiler during conversion or cleanup.

* gh-159739: Fix crashes in "xml.parsers.expat" when a character data
  callback disables buffering or clears another handler during a
  flush, or when interning an attribute name changes
  "ordered_attributes".

* gh-160299: Fix "symtable.Symbol.is_referenced()" for local and
  nonlocal symbols in function scopes when their only uses are in
  inlined comprehensions.

* gh-159739: Fix a crash when a "ctypes" structure subclass cannot be
  created due to an allocation failure.

* gh-159739: Fix clearing a "pickle.Unpickler" memo so that the
  unpickler can be reused for independent records.

* gh-160171: On the server side,
  "ssl.SSLSocket.get_unverified_chain()" now returns the client's
  certificate when the session was resumed from a session ticket,
  instead of an empty list, and returns an empty list instead of
  raising "AttributeError" when the client sent no certificate.

* gh-159739: Fix a possible crash in "abc.ABCMeta" instance checks
  when a subclass-checking callback changes the instance’s class.

* gh-159739: Fix the "truncate" method on "io.BytesIO" when converting
  its size argument closes the stream or exports its buffer.

* gh-159739: Fix "contextvars.ContextVar" returning a stale value
  after a reentrant finalizer changes it during "reset()".

* gh-159739: Detect recursive "_as_parameter_" chains for "ctypes"
  calls without argument types.

* gh-159739: Fix a possible crash when a list of "sqlite3" parameters
  is modified concurrently on a free-threaded build.

* gh-159739: Avoid a crash when a "threading.local" subclass finalizer
  accesses attributes after construction fails.

* gh-159739: Avoid a crash when a "queue.SimpleQueue" subclass
  finalizer adds an item after construction fails.

* gh-100609: "str()" of a "zipfile.Path" whose underlying zipfile has
  no filename, such as one constructed from an "io.BytesIO", now
  renders that filename as ":zipfile:" instead of raising "TypeError".
  The root of a zipfile is also no longer rendered with a trailing
  slash. Synchronized with zipp 3.23.1.

* gh-159690: Fix "logging.handlers.TimedRotatingFileHandler"
  permanently stopping rollover after a rollover failed or its backup
  file already existed, for example at a DST change.

* gh-159739: Avoid undefined behavior when "struct.pack_into()" copies
  a bytearray into overlapping output.

* gh-159739: Fix allocation error handling in the fallback
  implementation of "getaddrinfo()".

* gh-159739: Fix a double free if remote unwinder initialization runs
  out of memory.

* gh-159739: Fix "io.IOBase.readline()" returning more bytes than
  requested when a stream supports "peek()" and returns short reads.

* gh-159739: Fix multibyte encoders silently consuming a non-BMP
  character when looking up a two-character mapping.

* gh-159739: Fix off-by-one output buffer checks in the fallback
  implementation of "getnameinfo()".

* gh-159739: Fix reference cycles involving the types of grapheme
  iterators and segments created by "unicodedata.iter_graphemes()".

* gh-159706: Fix the pure-Python "zoneinfo.ZoneInfo" setting "fold=0"
  in "fromutc()" for times in the fold created by the only transition
  of a zone with a single transition.

* gh-159714: Fix "zoneinfo.ZoneInfo" interpreting the Julian day rule
  "J59" as February 29 in leap years instead of February 28.

* gh-159304: Fix "AttributeError" in
  "email.message.EmailMessage.get_body()" when a nested "multipart"
  part is malformed and its payload is a string.

* gh-158287: Fix a bug in "asyncio" where stopping a child process
  (such as with "SIGSTOP") on macOS caused the event loop to block
  indefinitely.

* gh-130698: Fix PyREPL to convert "sys.ps1" and "sys.ps2" to strings
  before use, and fall back to the default prompts if the conversion
  raises.

* gh-158126: Speed up "pickle.dumps()" and creating a "pickle.Pickler"
  by avoiding the creation of an "AttributeError" when looking up the
  optional "reducer_override" and "dispatch_table" attributes.

* gh-157880: Fix "mailbox.Babyl" to write the visible headers of a
  "mailbox.BabylMessage" to the mailbox file.

* gh-156784: "asyncio.ProactorEventLoop" no longer silently ignores
  "ConnectionResetError" on UDP sockets, matching
  "asyncio.SelectorEventLoop".

* gh-156078: "zipfile.ZipFile.mkdir()" now raises "ValueError" when
  the archive is closed or when a writable member handle is open.

* gh-155833: Ensure that MD5 and SHA* objects are properly GC-
  untracked before freeing their internal HACL* state. Patch by
  Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-155428: Ensure that "hmac.digest()" and "hmac.HMAC.digest()"
  output identical values when using a digest's block size smaller
  than 16. Patch by Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-155152: Improve performance of some "zipimport" archives that use
  Zstandard compression.

* gh-153679: "zipimport.zipimporter" now raises
  "zipimport.ZipImportError" instead of "UnicodeDecodeError" for a
  UTF-8-flagged file name that is not valid UTF-8. Patch by
  tonghuaroot.

* gh-153319: The "turtledemo" viewer now reads each demo script as
  UTF-8 instead of the locale encoding.

* gh-127636: Fix "tarfile.TarFile.extract()" to accept archive member
  names with a trailing forward slash, including those returned by
  "tarfile.TarFile.getnames()". Contributed by Xiao Yuan.

* gh-149527: "multiprocessing": fix creation of temporary socket files
  following gh-137335 (PR#148578 and corresponding backports). Patch
  by Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-146169: "xml.parsers.expat": raise "RuntimeError" when an Expat
  handler calls "parser.Parse" or "parser.ParseFile" on the parser
  that called the handler. Patch by Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-140036: Avoid hanging in floor division of pure Python
  "decimal.Decimal" instances when the context precision is very
  large. Patch by Bénédikt Tran.


Construção
----------

* gh-128883: Fix crashes with "-X perf" and "-X perf_jit" in BOLT
  builds. The ELF perf trampoline templates now use read-only data
  sections.

* gh-160004: Fix the paths in the **PEP 739** "build-details.json"
  file generated by "Tools/build/generate-build-details.py" with both
  "--relative-paths" and "--config-file-path". Previously, every path
  except "base_prefix" was wrong and depended on the directory the
  script was run from.

* gh-159998: Fix "libpython.dynamic" in the **PEP 739** "build-
  details.json" file for macOS and iOS framework builds. It now points
  at the framework's library instead of a nonexistent path under
  "lib/".

* gh-144942: Fix the macOS shared library and framework builds not
  linking the libraries required by built-in modules, such as the
  HACL* objects needed by "_blake2" when it is built in via
  "Modules/Setup.local".

* gh-159819: Fix the shell version of **python3-config** (used on all
  POSIX platforms except macOS) when the installation prefix contains
  spaces or other characters special to the shell or **sed**: it
  printed an empty "--prefix" and wrong "--includes"/"--ldflags" paths
  while exiting successfully. The script now also exits with status 1
  if it cannot determine its installation prefix.

* gh-157354: Fix the "--with-*name*-sanitizer=no" and "--
  without-*name*-sanitizer" **configure** options enabling the
  sanitizer instead of disabling it.

* gh-155813: On macOS, "LIBFFI_CFLAGS" and "LIBFFI_LIBS" are no longer
  ignored when the SDK provides "libffi", so "ctypes" can again be
  built against a different "libffi". Patch by Advit Arora.


API C
-----

* gh-159739: Avoid a crash if a context watcher is cleared while other
  context watchers are being notified.


Python 3.15.1 final
===================

*Release date: 2026-10-21*


Segurança
---------

* gh-159894: Bump the version of pip bundled in "ensurepip" to version
  26.2.2.

* gh-159428: "mimetypes" no longer reads the files listed in
  "mimetypes.knownfiles" by default on Windows, and uses only the
  registry.

* gh-157953: Update bundled libexpat to version 2.9.0.


Núcleo e embutidos
------------------

* gh-159739: Avoid a crash if allocation fails while creating a
  "string.templatelib.Template" iterator.

* gh-159739: Propagate errors during generic class construction and
  avoid a crash after failed generic alias substitution.

* gh-159739: Raise "OverflowError" when the absolute value of a
  dynamic printf-style formatting width is too large.

* gh-159739: Fix a reference leak in "gc.get_objects()" and
  "gc.get_referrers()" when an internal allocation fails in the free-
  threaded build.

* gh-159739: Fix memory leaks during interpreter startup when a path
  configuration file is empty or too large, or when an audit hook
  rejects a command.

* gh-159739: Avoid a crash when an interpreter configuration string
  cannot be encoded as UTF-8.

* gh-159739: Preserve the original "SyntaxError" if allocating
  optional error metadata fails.

* gh-159739: Avoid a crash if formatting an integer with the "c"
  presentation type runs out of memory.

* gh-159739: Avoid a crash when a module filename cannot be encoded as
  UTF-8.

* gh-159603: On FreeBSD, call "pthread_attr_get_np()" to get the stack
  size (and guard size) of the current thread. Patch by Victor
  Stinner.

* gh-130279: Fix bug where compiler did not set the right exception
  handler for some jump instructions.

* gh-159430: Report the correct exception if looking up "__bytes__()"
  raises an exception while performing %-formatting of "bytes".

* gh-159320: Add dynamic detection of stack sizes on Android, allowing
  safer deep recursion.

* gh-159288: Fix a crash when walking a very long chain of lazy import
  placeholders, as created by an aliased dotted import such as "lazy
  import a.b.c as d". "RecursionError" is now raised instead.

* gh-159285: Fix a crash in a debug build when copying an empty "dict"
  fails with "MemoryError". Patch by Christian Aurich Zanettini
  Martins.

* gh-159041: Fix a use-after-free in "asyncio" task bookkeeping when a
  finalizer creates a task during thread shutdown.

* gh-158973: Reset the warnings lock in the child after "os.fork()",
  before clearing other threads' states, to avoid deadlocks when their
  finalizers issue warnings. Preserve the lock's recursion depth if
  the forking thread owns it.

* gh-158918: Reduce C stack usage of "_PyModule_IsPossiblyShadowing",
  which could potentially cause stack overflows during module
  attribute access while deeply recursing in agressively optimized
  builds.

* gh-158803: Fix a crash in "bytes.join()" and "bytearray.join()" in
  the *free-threaded build* when another thread concurrently mutates
  the list being joined. Patch by Christian Aurich Zanettini Martins.

* gh-158824: Fix module-level "__getattr__()" being called before a
  module's own lazy imports were resolved, which allowed it to shadow
  them.

* gh-158820: Fix a crash when a lazy import is declared or resolved by
  a finalizer running during interpreter shutdown.

* gh-158592: Skip the array reallocation when shrinking a small
  "list". Patch by Donghee Na.

* gh-158583: "bytes.fromhex()" and "bytearray.fromhex()": Fix
  uninitialized memory read. Patch by Victor Stinner.

* gh-158197: Fix crashes and debug-build assertion failures in the
  *free-threaded build* when iterating over a split dictionary while
  another thread deletes entries or clears it. Publish insertion-order
  updates atomically so readers cannot observe an increased size
  before the corresponding order entry is initialized.

* gh-158592: "del list[index]" now triggers shrinking the list's
  internal array.

* gh-158486: Fix the PowerSort mask calculation in "list.sort()" for
  very large lists.

* gh-158121: Fix missing "sys.monitoring" "INSTRUCTION" events when a
  "LINE" callback returns "sys.monitoring.DISABLE".

* gh-158219: Fix "bytearray" constructor: do not use a bytes object if
  its hash value is already computed. Patch by Cody Maloney and Victor
  Stinner.

* gh-158072: Fix a JIT crash when a class is instantiated with their
  default arguments

* gh-157468: Fix the JIT optimizer folding a builtin name to a
  constant taken from the interpreter's builtins dictionary even when
  the running function uses a different "__builtins__" mapping, such
  as one created with "vars(builtins).copy()". The optimizer now only
  folds when the function's builtins is the interpreter's, and the
  folded constant is guarded at runtime so that another function
  sharing the same code object but a different builtins mapping does
  not use it.

* gh-157242: If "bytearray.resize()" or "bytearray.take_bytes()"
  fails, leave the "bytearray" unchanged, instead of clearing it.
  Patch by Victor Stinner.

* gh-156091: Fix a crash when compiling deeply nested inlined list,
  set, or dict comprehensions. A "SyntaxError" is now raised when the
  nesting exceeds the compiler's static block limit.

* gh-106045: Fix standard library discovery in virtual environments
  created from a Python executable symlink located outside its base
  installation.

* gh-156459: Fix cleanup on error in "compiler_set_qualname".
  Previously it was called in "_PyCompile_EnterScope", after the scope
  had been entered, and this was not reversed in case of an error.

* gh-156371: Fix missing "PyRefTracer_DESTROY" events for trashcan
  deferred objects. Patch by Donghee Na.

* gh-156204: Fix a crash in "PyErr_GivenExceptionMatches()" when
  evaluating deeply nested exception tuples. The recursion is now
  bounded, and exceeding the limit is reported as an unraisable
  exception.

* gh-155823: Fix a JIT bug where the side exit taken when a virtual
  iterator is exhausted left a stale value on the stack, so the tier
  one interpreter resumed with corrupted state and "yield from" raised
  "AttributeError" instead of finishing normally.

* gh-155504: Fix a crash when thread state creation fails before the
  thread state is fully initialized.

* gh-155315: Fix "marshal" so that a "frozendict" referenced more than
  once in the serialized data round-trips correctly, instead of
  failing to load with "ValueError". Patch by tonghuaroot.

* gh-154937: Fix a data race on thread handle identifiers when
  "_thread._shutdown()" runs concurrently with the startup of non-
  daemon threads in the *free-threaded build*.

* gh-152075: Reduced lock contention during LOAD_GLOBAL bytecode
  specialization under free threading.

* gh-153578: Fix an out-of-bounds write in "bytearray.extend()" when
  the bytearray is resized while the argument's "__buffer__()" is
  being acquired, for example by another thread. Patch by tonghuaroot.

* gh-151895: Fixed a crash in "marshal.loads()" when an allocation
  failed while loading a reference-tracked dictionary; it now raises
  "MemoryError".

* gh-151518: Fix a free-threaded stop-the-world fairness issue that
  could starve a thread reattaching after being suspended while
  detached.

* gh-149816: Fix a Use-After-Free race condition in
  "subtype_getweakref()" during concurrent weakref creation and
  destruction in the free-threading build.

* gh-149816: Fix race conditions in "invoke_gc_callback" iterating
  "gc.callbacks" in free-threading mode.

* gh-69605: Fix *REPL* completions inserted incorrectly when there was
  spaces in import statements.


Biblioteca
----------

* gh-138641: Ignore "pdb.set_trace()" when called directly at the
  "pdb" prompt.

* gh-159864: Fix a crash in "syslog.openlog()" under the free-threaded
  build when "sys.argv" is modified concurrently.

* gh-159811: Fix a crash in "hashlib" when the OpenSSL routine used by
  "hash.update()" or by hash object constructors fails on data larger
  than 2048 bytes. Patch by Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-159811: Fix a crash in "hmac" when the OpenSSL routine used by
  "hmac.HMAC.update()" or by "hmac.new()" fails on data larger than
  2048 bytes. Patch by Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-159786: Fix the error handling of the HACL* routine used by
  "hmac.new()" and "hmac.HMAC.update()". If the maximum input length
  of the underlying hash function is exceeded, an "OverflowError" is
  now raised on all builds, instead of crashing on DEBUG builds and
  being silently ignored otherwise. Code correctness. Realistically
  this can only happen at implausible sizes. Patch by Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-159739: Fix copying "collections.deque" subclasses with a large
  maximum length.

* gh-159739: Allow cyclic garbage collection to reclaim group records
  returned by "grp".

* gh-159739: Fix "io.BytesIO" reads into overlapping views of the same
  buffer.

* gh-159739: Avoid a crash when memory allocation fails while creating
  a "collections.OrderedDict" items iterator.

* gh-159739: Avoid reading past the end of an encoding name when the
  "surrogatepass" error handler receives a truncated UTF-16 or UTF-32
  name.

* gh-159739: Fix incorrect "ctypes" scalar values after
  "ctypes.resize()" enlarges the object.

* gh-159739: Fix a memory leak when Unicode normalization cannot grow
  its temporary buffer.

* gh-159739: Fix resource leaks in "ssl" when certificate conversion
  or key log setup fails.

* gh-149015: Fix "bdb.Bdb.clear_all_file_breaks()" leaving breakpoints
  behind when multiple breakpoints are set on the same line.

* gh-159620: Fix "python -m asyncio ps", "pstree" and async-aware
  "profiling.sampling" stacks stopping at asynchronous generators.
  Patch by Timofei Ivankov.

* gh-159458: Fix a ThreadSanitizer data race on the static cache in
  "normalize_century()" of the datetime module under the free-threaded
  build.

* gh-159430: Report the correct exception if looking up "__name__"
  raises an exception when calling "repr()" on a "weakref.ref".

* gh-159225: Prevent "input" calls in PyREPL from modifying readline
  history.

* gh-159044: Restore the previous behaviour of
  "http.client.HTTPConnection.set_tunnel()" where header values that
  are not strings (such as "None", "int" or other objects) are
  converted with "str" instead of raising "AttributeError" when the
  request is sent.

* gh-159184: Fix "marshal.dumps()" raising "MemoryError" for a set or
  frozenset containing several complex NaNs, which also made it
  impossible to write a ".pyc" file for source code containing such a
  constant.

* gh-159185: Fix a crash in "marshal.dumps()" and "marshal.dump()"
  when a set is modified while its elements are serialized, for
  example by the "__buffer__()" method of one of its elements.
  "RuntimeError" is now raised.

* gh-159049: Fix reference cycles in
  "asyncio.loop.create_connection()" and "asyncio.loop.start_tls()"
  after a failed TLS handshake. Patch by Timofei Ivankov.

* gh-87720: Fixed error in "email" new policies where header folding
  failed to detect the need to re-quote text obtained from encoded
  words in certain cases.

* gh-158929: Fix crash when calling "syslog.syslog()" while a
  subinterpreter in another thread calls "syslog.openlog()" or
  "syslog.closelog()".

* gh-158936: "dataclass()" no longer fails when a string annotation
  names a lazy import that cannot be resolved, matching the behavior
  for non-string annotations.

* gh-158893: Make "os.strerror()" thread-safe: use the reentrant
  "strerror_r()" function if available. Patch by Victor Stinner.

* gh-158539: Fix macOS runtime section lookup for remote debugging
  when virtual memory region sizes differ from Mach-O segment file
  sizes.

* gh-156545: Fix deep flamegraph exports on platforms with small C
  stacks by falling back to the Python JSON encoder when the C encoder
  runs out of stack space.

* gh-158552: Wait for Windows threads to finish suspending before
  reading target memory in the sampling profiler's blocking mode.
  Resume the target if waiting for suspension fails.

* gh-156321: Fix "asyncio.shield()" reporting an exception from the
  inner future through the loop exception handler as soon as it
  completes after the shield was cancelled, even when the exception is
  retrieved afterwards. The exception is now reported only if it is
  never retrieved, as with any other future.

* gh-158539: Fix "profiling.sampling" exception mode discarding
  samples for code running inside an "except" block in a generator or
  coroutine. The remote debugger now follows "tstate->exc_info" and
  its "previous_item" chain instead of only reading the embedded
  "exc_state", matching the exception that "sys.exception()" reports.

* gh-158563: Fix "turtle.undo()" after "turtle.teleport()" and after
  an exception in "turtle.circle()", "turtle.dot()" or
  "turtle.write()". Fix "turtle.stamp()", "turtle.clearstamp()",
  "turtle.clear()" and "turtle.reset()" when the undo buffer is
  disabled.

* gh-158540: Fix "profiling.sampling" not adding the directory
  containing the profiled script to "sys.path", which prevented the
  script from importing modules placed next to it.  The script's
  directory is now added, matching the behavior of "python script.py".

* gh-158522: Fix "profiling.sampling" showing a single frame for a
  task whose coroutine recurses. Patch by Timofei Ivankov.

* gh-158169: Fix "zlib.Decompress.unconsumed_tail" duplicating
  "unused_data" after end of stream when *max_length* was used.

* gh-158004: Fix "asyncio.as_completed()" to continue yielding every
  awaitable after a pending iteration step is cancelled.

* gh-153888: Fix "unittest.mock.patch()" with "autospec", "spec", or
  "spec_set" when used with lazy-imported objects.

* gh-157672: Corrige o "tkinter" no macOS: a criação de uma instância
  de "Tk" não substitui mais os manipuladores Python para SIGINT,
  SIGHUP e SIGTERM pelo manipulador do Tk que encerra o processo;
  assim, Ctrl-C volta a levantar "KeyboardInterrupt".

* gh-157621: Fix a crash when a weak-reference callback is attached to
  a "typing.ParamSpecArgs" or "typing.ParamSpecKwargs" instance.

* gh-69919: "code.InteractiveInterpreter.runsource()" and the REPL now
  report any exception raised by compiling the source, such as
  "MemoryError" or "RecursionError" for too deeply nested source,
  instead of propagating it or printing a traceback of the REPL
  internals.

* gh-157451: Fix "gettext" plural form selection when the "Plural-
  Forms" expression combines the unary "!" operator with a binary
  operator, for example "!n + 1" or "2 * !n".  The latter raised
  "SyntaxError".

* gh-157406: Corrige a implementação em Python de
  "xml.etree.ElementTree.XMLParser": o método "doctype()" do destino
  agora é chamado para uma declaração de tipo de documento sem
  identificador externo, como "<!DOCTYPE html>", assim como na
  implementação em C.

* gh-157364: Fix a use-after-free in "io.TextIOWrapper" when a call to
  the underlying buffer reentrantly detaches it. Patched by Shamil
  Abdulaev.

* gh-157242: "io.BytesIO" is no longer closed on "write()" and
  "truncate()" failure ("MemoryError"). Patch by Victor Stinner.

* gh-157325: Fix an out-of-bounds read in the "hz" incremental decoder
  when the input ends with "~".

* gh-123018: Fix "readline.write_history_file()" and
  "readline.append_history_file()" producing a history file that
  "readline.read_history_file()" could not load when a limit was set
  with "readline.set_history_length()" and Python was built against
  "libedit".  This works around NetBSD PR 60322.

* gh-157146: "linecache" can now read the source of a module that was
  imported from a zip archive on "sys.path" when given only the file
  name, as "pdb", "warnings" and "doctest" do.

* gh-157048: Preserve the position and contents of "io.BytesIO" when
  "BytesIO.__init__()" fails because a buffer is exported.

* gh-156961: Corrige "tkinter.font.nametofont()" e o construtor
  "tkinter.font.Font" para um nome de fonte retornado pelo Tk como um
  objeto Tcl — por exemplo, por "ttk.Style.lookup()".

* gh-156946: Fix a crash in "curses.panel" when the finalizer of a
  panel's user pointer runs while the panel is being deallocated.  The
  panel is now taken off the panel stack before its user pointer is
  dropped.

* gh-156920: Fix "asyncio" on Windows: closing a "DatagramTransport"
  under "ProactorEventLoop" while datagrams were still queued, or
  while an in-flight write failed right as "close()" was draining the
  buffer, could strand the queued data and never call
  "connection_lost()", hanging the close indefinitely.

* gh-156810: Fix a "UnicodeEncodeError" crash in the sampling
  profiler's collapsed-stack export ("--collapsed") when a sampled
  frame's function or file name contains non-ASCII or surrogate-
  escaped characters. The output file is now written as UTF-8.

* gh-156797: Fix "xml.sax.saxutils.XMLGenerator": the namespace URI is
  now escaped in the namespace declaration.  Previously a URI
  containing "&", "<" or a quote character produced a document which
  cannot be parsed.

* gh-83895: o "xml.etree.ElementTree" agora aceita entradas maiores
  que 2 GiB na implementação em C. Os dados são fornecidos ao Expat em
  blocos — como o "xml.parsers.expat" já fazia — em vez de levantar
  uma "OverflowError".

* gh-99064: Corrige "xml.etree.ElementTree.parse()" ao lidar com um
  arquivo de texto ou outra fonte de dados do tipo "str" na
  implementação em C. A codificação declarada no documento era
  aplicada ao texto já decodificado, resultando em *mojibake*; agora,
  ela é ignorada, assim como ocorre ao analisar com "XMLParser.feed()"
  ou "fromstring()".

* gh-156713: Fix "nturl2path.pathname2url()" and
  "nturl2path.url2pathname()": the filesystem encoding and error
  handler are now used for percent-encoding and decoding, as in
  "urllib.request".  Previously paths containing surrogate characters
  raised "UnicodeEncodeError".

* gh-156698: Fix "asyncio.ProactorEventLoop" UDP transports so that a
  write error no longer strands a paused protocol: the write loop is
  now rescheduled when data remains buffered, and the protocol is
  resumed when the buffer has drained.

* gh-156658: "xml.dom" and "xml.etree.ElementTree" no longer treat
  characters which are not white space in XML (such as U+00A0) as
  white space. Previously they could be lost in "indent()",
  "canonicalize()" with "strip_text=True", and when parsing with the
  "whitespace-in-element-content" feature turned off.

* gh-156568: "zipapp.create_archive()" now correctly sets the
  executable bit on the target archive when copying a zipapp where the
  target is a path-like object.

* gh-156545: Fix the sampling profiler's flamegraph export so that
  profiling a deeply recursive program no longer fails with
  "RecursionError" instead of producing a flamegraph. Patch by
  tonghuaroot.

* gh-156476: The pure Python implementation of
  "queue.SimpleQueue.get()" now ignores *timeout* when *block* is
  false, matching the documented behavior and the C implementation. It
  previously raised "ValueError".

* gh-156444: Fix matching of a negated character set in a bytes
  pattern compiled with both "re.IGNORECASE" and "re.LOCALE".  The
  case closure is now applied to the members of the set, so that
  "[^bc]" no longer matches "b'B'".

* gh-156180: "zlib.adler32_combine()" e "zlib.crc32_combine()" agora
  levantam "ValueError" se o argumento *len2* for negativo, em vez de
  retornarem valores inválidos ou travarem indefinidamente,
  respectivamente.

* gh-156166: "ssl": A failed assignment or deletion of the
  "_msg_callback" attribute of "ssl.SSLContext" no longer removes the
  current callback. Deleting it now raises "AttributeError" instead of
  "TypeError".

* gh-156173: Calling "zlib.Decompress.flush()" on invalid compressed
  data now raises "zlib.error" instead of being silently ignored.

* gh-152817: "sqlite3": Impede a remoção do atributo "row_factory" de
  um cursor para evitar uma falha durante uma consulta.

* gh-156124: Fix a crash in the free-threaded build when deleting the
  "contents" attribute of a "ctypes" pointer.

* gh-156101: Fix "sqlite3.Cursor.arraysize" being set to 0 if the
  assigned value is too large. The attribute is now left unchanged if
  the assignment fails.

* gh-156100: Fix crashes in "sqlite3.Connection" when deleting the
  "autocommit" attribute or setting it to an integer which does not
  fit in C long. Both now raise an exception.

* gh-156099: Corrige uma falha ao excluir o atributo "keylog_filename"
  de "ssl.SSLContext". Agora, isso levanta uma exceção
  "AttributeError".

* gh-156067: Fix error handling in the "zoneinfo" accelerator module
  when a transition index is "-1" or a TZ string's "__bool__" raises.

* gh-155997: Fix "concurrent.interpreters.list_all()".  It failed if
  an interpreter was destroyed during the call, in particular by a
  garbage collection which finalized the object owning the last
  reference to it.

* gh-155941: Fix "asyncio.start_server()" when a plain-function
  *client_connected_cb* raises: the error is now reported like the
  coroutine case and the transport is closed, instead of leaving the
  connection open forever (which also made
  "asyncio.Server.wait_closed()" hang).

* gh-155843: "hmac": ensure that HMAC objects are properly initialized
  to prevent rare crashes on allocation failures. Patch by Bénédikt
  Tran.

* gh-155835: "hashlib": Fix data races when accessing "digest_size"
  and "block_size" on SHA-3 objects. Patch by Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-155830: "_blake2": Ensure that BLAKE-2 objects are correctly
  initialized before being tracked by the garbage collector. Patch by
  Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-155782: "ssl": prevent a crash in "group()" for session-less
  objects on OpenSSL 3.2 and later. Patch by Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-155811: Add a sequence counter to GC statistics to prevent
  "_remote_debugging" returning inconsistent snapshots caused by non-
  atomic reads. Patch by Maurycy Pawłowski-Wieroński.

* gh-155717: "multiprocessing"'s default start method is now "spawn"
  instead of ""forkserver"" when there is no writable temporary
  directory, such as on a read-only file system. Previously starting a
  process failed with an "OSError" there. Patch by Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-155775: Fix a regression in "imaplib" introduced in the fix for
  gh-63121: refreshing the capabilities after a successful "login()"
  or "authenticate()" consumed the "CAPABILITY" response, so it could
  no longer be read with "response()".

* gh-113318: Corrige falhas ao excluir um atributo cujo método
  *setter* é gerado pela Clínica de Argumentos e não está preparado
  para a exclusão, incluindo "frame.f_trace_opcodes" e os atributos
  "context", "owner" e "session" de "_ssl._SSLSocket". A exclusão de
  tal atributo agora levanta uma "AttributeError".

* gh-150449: Corrige fatias de "sqlite3.Blob" com passo negativo. A
  leitura ou escrita de tal fatia levantava  "SystemError". Agora,
  levanta "ValueError".

* gh-155336: Fix error handling in "socket.gethostbyaddr()" and
  "socket.gethostbyname_ex()" when hostname resolution fails.

* gh-155426: Make sure that the pure Python fallback of
  "hmac.digest()" rejects keys that are neither "bytes" or
  "bytearray". Previously, an "AttributeError" was raised instead of
  "TypeError". Patch by Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-102475: Fix "os.path.realpath()" on Windows: the unresolved part
  of the path is now appended, not joined, so a file name which looks
  like a drive (e.g. "spam:eggs") no longer discards the resolved
  part.  A path relative to another drive is now resolved against the
  root directory of that drive.

* gh-89760: Corrige "os.path.realpath()" no Windows: o prefixo "\\?\"
  não é mais removido de caminhos com GUID de volume, o que tornava o
  resultado inválido.

* gh-84419: Corrige "os.stat()" no Windows: pontos e espaços ao final
  do nome, que são ignorados pelo sistema operacional, não são mais
  levados em consideração ao inferir as permissões de execução a
  partir da extensão do arquivo.

* gh-155319: "warnings.warn_explicit()" now displays the source line
  taken from the loader of the module whose globals are passed as
  *module_globals*.  It also no longer raises "IndexError" if *lineno*
  is out of the range of the module source.

* gh-123011: "warnings.warn_explicit()" no longer emits a spurious
  "DeprecationWarning" or raises "ImportError" when it is called with
  the globals of the "__main__" module.

* gh-69370: **python -m inspect --details** no longer fails with
  "UnicodeEncodeError" if the path of the module contains characters
  unencodable in the encoding of "sys.stdout".  Such characters are
  now escaped with backslashes.

* gh-69371: Fix "pydoc" for modules whose path contains undecodable
  bytes. "pydoc.writedoc()" and the pydoc HTTP server no longer fail
  with "UnicodeEncodeError": the file URL is now percent-encoded using
  the filesystem encoding, and characters unencodable in the generated
  HTML page are escaped with backslashes.

* gh-154855: Corrige "curses.window.instr()" retornava um caractere a
  menos quando o módulo "curses" era compilado com uma biblioteca
  curses que conta o caractere terminador no comprimento solicitado,
  como a do NetBSD.

* gh-154594: Fix "copy.deepcopy()" so that an object whose deep copy
  is "None" is still memoized. Patch by tonghuaroot.

* gh-154523: Fixed data-race when calling "io.TextIOBase.detach()" in
  *free-threaded build*.

* gh-135683: "logging.FileHandler" and
  "logging.handlers.WatchedFileHandler" now honor
  "logging.raiseExceptions" for errors that occur while opening the
  file, like for other errors during logging.

* gh-82535: "logging.handlers.SysLogHandler" no longer fails if the
  address cannot be resolved when the handler is created. The address
  is resolved again when a record is emitted.

* gh-153970: Calling "str()" on a "subprocess.CalledProcessError" no
  longer raises "TypeError" when its "returncode" is not an integer,
  such as "None".

* gh-154194: Fix the sampling profiler dropping entire samples when a
  non-fatal read fails; frames now keep any readable metadata, and
  long funcnames and filenames are truncated instead. Patch by Maurycy
  Pawłowski-Wieroński.

* gh-153005: "concurrent.interpreters.Queue.get()" and
  "concurrent.interpreters.Queue.put()" now compute their "timeout"
  deadline from "time.monotonic()" instead of the wall clock, so
  adjusting the system clock during the call no longer makes them
  over- or under-wait.

* gh-154062: Stop normalizing differential flamegraph baselines to the
  duration of the current profile.

* gh-81241: Fix "OSError" when importing "ctypes" from a statically
  linked interpreter.

* gh-153838: Skip non-regular files in the "profiling.sampling"
  heatmap exporter instead of reading them unconditionally.  Patch by
  tonghuaroot.

* gh-141276: Fix duplicate "SyntaxWarning" messages when importing
  source modules from ZIP archives.
  "zipimport.zipimporter.get_filename()", and therefore "find_spec()",
  no longer compile source modules. A "SyntaxError" in a zipped source
  module is now raised when the module is executed rather than when it
  is found, matching the behavior of filesystem-based loaders.

* gh-153603: Fix a crash in the ISO-2022 decoders when decoding a byte
  after an unknown charset designation is set via the decoder's
  "setstate" method. Patch by tonghuaroot.

* gh-153539: Corrige uma falha na implementação do C de
  "io.TextIOWrapper.tell()" quando o método "getstate" do
  decodificador aciona uma busca reentrante, ou quando outro thread
  busca o mesmo fluxo simultaneamente. Patch por tonghuaroot.

* gh-152754: Fix a crash when the same "os.scandir()" iterator is used
  concurrently from multiple threads.  It no longer releases the
  directory handle while another thread is reading from it.  Sharing
  an iterator between threads remains subject to race conditions:
  which entries each thread receives is unspecified.

* gh-153364: Make frame, coroutine and task-waiter walks iterative and
  bounded, avoiding potential hangs and stack overflows. Fix asyncio
  task inspection when awaited-by sets contain removed entries. Patch
  by Maurycy Pawłowski-Wieroński.

* gh-149816: "hashlib": fix a crash arising from a race condition when
  looking up an OpenSSL hash algorithm by name the first time. Patch
  by Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-151292: Fix "profiling.sampling --binary" leaving unreadable
  profile files when the binary format reaches a size limit. Preserve
  collected samples when the writer can still finalize safely. Patch
  by Maurycy Pawłowski-Wieroński.

* gh-152721: Fix quadratic replay time in the "profiling.sampling"
  binary reader when a profile's run-length-encoded samples alternate
  thread status.

* gh-151126: Corrige uma falha causada pela não definição de
  "MemoryError" em caso de falha de alocação ao passar instâncias de
  "ctypes.Structure" ou "ctypes.Union" por valor para funções externas
  do ctypes.

* gh-152692: Fix "annotationlib.type_repr()" returning a string such
  as "None.list.append" for bound built-in methods, whose "__module__"
  is "None".  It now returns the qualified name, as it already did for
  other builtins.

* gh-152490: Fix "TypeError" when formatting a "SyntaxError" raised
  with "NotImplemented" as its argument, which caused unexpected REPL
  exit and IDLE Shell restart.

* gh-152373: Fix the "pdb" "until" command not stepping over a list
  comprehension when a breakpoint is set on it. Patch by tonghuaroot.

* gh-152204: Fix the pure-Python implementations of
  "datetime.date.fromisoformat()", "datetime.time.fromisoformat()" and
  "datetime.datetime.fromisoformat()" silently accepting some
  malformed ISO 8601 strings, such as non-ASCII digits or a sign in a
  fixed-width field (for example "'2020+12'" or "'20201212T0102٣٤'").
  Each field is now required to be exactly *N* ASCII digits, matching
  the C implementation.

* gh-133998: Fix "tarfile.open()" in streaming write mode ("w|gz")
  raising "struct.error" when given an *mtime* outside the range of
  the gzip header's 32-bit timestamp field.  Out-of-range values are
  now stored as "0", matching "gzip".

* gh-117807: Fix "mimetypes" initialization from MIME map files
  containing invalid UTF-8 bytes.

* gh-143008: Corrige condições de corrida ao re-inicializar um objeto
  "io.TextIOWrapper".

* gh-145856: Fix "plistlib.dumps()" and "plistlib.dump()" so that
  "skipkeys=True" together with "sort_keys=True" correctly drops non-
  string keys when the dictionary contains a mix of string and non-
  string keys.  Previously the sort ran before the filter and raised
  "TypeError".

* gh-143376: "concurrent.interpreters": fix a crash when internal
  cross-interpreter channel ends have incorrect channel IDs. Patch by
  Bénédikt Tran.

* gh-146065: Fix a crash in asyncio.Future iterator when send() is
  called after throw() or close().

* gh-143008: Fix crash in "io.TextIOWrapper" when reentrant
  "io.TextIOBase.detach()" is called reentrantly from the underlying
  buffer.

* gh-129605: Improve exception handling when computing suggestions in
  traceback.py. This fixes a bug that could cause PyREPL to exit
  unexpectedly.

* gh-102967: A bug in "doctest._SpoofOut.truncate()" was causing None
  to be passed to "StringIO.seek()" when no size was given. A simple
  fix skips the seek call when no size is given so the buffer can be
  truncated from the current position.

* gh-82039: "http.cookiejar.FileCookieJar.load()" now checks the
  first, format signature line in a case-insensitive manner. Patch by
  Ashley Harvey.

* gh-70758: Creating a new "turtle" screen after the previous one was
  closed no longer raises "turtle.Terminator" on the first turtle
  command.

* bpo-44012: The "exploded" attribute of "ipaddress.IPv6Address" and
  "ipaddress.IPv6Interface" now supports addresses with a scope ID
  (link-local addresses). Previously the former raised
  "AddressValueError" and the latter omitted the scope ID.

* gh-83869: Fix "tarfile" reading an archive with a GNU sparse 1.0
  member whose size is set in the pax extended header. The offset of
  the next header was computed from the offset of the data, which is
  already past the sparse map, and from the size of the member, which
  can be the apparent size of the sparse file. All following members
  were unreachable.

* gh-61366: "http.cookiejar.MozillaCookieJar" now reads session
  cookies written by curl and Wget, which use "0" in the expiration
  time field. Contributed by Jérémie Detrey.


Documentação
------------

* gh-142083: Document the "'w'" type code in the "array.array"
  docstring, so that it lists the same type codes as "array.typecodes"
  and the "array" module documentation.

* gh-107689: Added docstrings to abstract ctypes.


Testes
------

* gh-159293: Restore the recursion limit after the free-threading
  recursion-limit race test to avoid failures in subsequent tests run
  in the same process.

* gh-159211: The iOS testbed no longer gathers simulator diagnostics
  when a test run fails.

* gh-157628: In regrtest, only consider that a test leaks if all test
  runs leak at least one file descriptor. For example, ignore "[0, 1,
  -1] file descriptors, sum=0" deltas, instead of reporting a leak.
  Patch by Victor Stinner.

* gh-140550: Enable limited C API tests on Free Threading in test_cext
  and test_cppext: test the "Py_TARGET_ABI3T" macro. Patch by Victor
  Stinner.

* gh-75876: A test decorated with "bigmemtest()" now runs in a
  subprocess if it really allocates the memory it asks for (that is,
  if the "-M" option is used), so that the memory it uses and the
  address space it fragments are released when it ends.  A dummy run
  stays in the process.  The separate memory watchdog process is no
  longer needed: the parent process watches the memory usage of the
  subprocess.

* gh-155411: Fix "test.support.subTests()" for asynchronous test
  methods.  They were wrapped in a synchronous function, which
  discarded the coroutine without awaiting it, so the test silently
  did not run at all.

* gh-132581: The list of tests which altered the execution environment
  now includes the reasons why the environment was considered altered,
  for example an unraisable exception or a modified "sys.path".  The
  final result no longer repeats the same state twice (like "ENV
  CHANGED then ENV CHANGED").

* gh-155109: Add "test.support.run_with_limited_c_stack()" and use it
  in tests that exhaust the C stack with a fixed number of recursive
  calls, so that their outcome no longer depends on the C stack size.


Construção
----------

* gh-143632: Fix the check that disables "PR_SET_VMA_ANON_NAME" on
  musl libc: it tested an unset variable, so it never had any effect
  and the build could fail with a redefinition of "struct
  prctl_mm_map".

* gh-159759: Fix the "libpython.static" path in **PEP 739** "build-
  details.json", which pointed to a file that is not installed when
  building with "--enable-shared", and no longer list a static library
  for framework builds, which do not install one.

* gh-159440: The version string reported by "sys.version" no longer
  carries a spurious "-dirty" suffix when CPython is built out-of-tree
  from a clean git checkout: the build stamp now checks the source
  tree instead of the build directory.

* gh-158683: Fix the "Modules/Setup" entry for the "_zstd" module by
  adding missing source files.

* gh-157142: Fix the link of "Programs/_freeze_module" when extension
  modules are built in ("MODULE_BUILDTYPE=static") and the test
  modules are enabled: "Modules/getpath_noop.c" now defines
  "_Py_Get_Getpath_CodeObject()", which "_testinternalcapi" uses.

* gh-155911: Corrige a detecção do curses quando uma biblioteca curses
  já está em "LIBS". Patch por Shamil Abdulaev.


Windows
-------

* gh-159880: Fix a key handle leak in "winreg.CreateKey()",
  "winreg.CreateKeyEx()" and "winreg.OpenKey()" when the
  "winreg.OpenKey/result" audit hook fails.

* gh-157906: Fix an incorrect architecture macro check that prevented
  CPU prefetching in the free-threaded garbage collector on 32-bit
  Windows builds.

* gh-157789: Use compiler option "-Og" in case of clang-cl debug
  builds on Windows to reduce stack usage. Patch by Chris Eibl.

* gh-72353: Reading from the console on Windows now continues if the
  read was cancelled by Ctrl+C, but the "SIGINT" handler did not raise
  an exception.  Previously the read ended as if at end of file.

* gh-86427: Fix the encoding of the standard streams in the legacy
  Windows stdio mode ("PYTHONLEGACYWINDOWSSTDIO").  It is now the code
  page of the console, as in Python 3.7, not the ANSI code page.

* gh-87587: "os.device_encoding()" on Windows now returns the code
  page of any console file descriptor, not only 0, 1 and 2, and
  returns "None" for other character devices like "NUL".  The UTF-8
  code page is now reported as ""utf-8"" instead of ""cp65001"".


macOS
-----

* gh-159739: Propagate errors that occur while converting macOS system
  proxy settings.


IDLE
----

* gh-159517: Fix the completion list and the call tip grabbing the
  focus on macOS with Tcl/Tk 9.1.

* gh-56596: Faz com que os atalhos de teclado do IDLE que utilizam
  letras ASCII funcionem com o Caps Lock ativado, mesmo quando apenas
  uma das versões (maiúscula ou minúscula) estiver definida.

* gh-64007: O IDLE não aplica mais coloração de sintaxe ao texto
  inserido para "input()" no Console.

* gh-85560: Corrige a falha do IDLE em encontrar o parêntese de
  abertura quando uma linha de continuação dentro dos parênteses
  começa com "else" de uma expressão condicional ou com "yield".

* gh-75487: Corrige o salvamento de um número truncado quando um campo
  de número inteiro na caixa de diálogo de configurações do IDLE é
  esvaziado usando a tecla Backspace.

* gh-74112: Ctrl-C in the IDLE Shell now interrupts blocking calls
  such as "time.sleep()" and "socket.recv".

* gh-151471: Colorize the soft keyword "type" in IDLE.

* gh-103089: IDLE no longer hangs when opening a file with very long
  lines. Only the first 2,000 characters of a line are colorized.

* gh-70331: IDLE no longer fails to start with "python -m idlelib",
  and its user process no longer fails to start, when the current
  directory contains user files with the same names as standard
  library modules that IDLE imports, such as "random.py" or
  "tkinter.py".

* gh-93016: Fix parsing of command line arguments in the IDLE "Run...
  Customized" dialog on Windows: backslashes are no longer treated as
  escape characters. Fix also display of the previous arguments in the
  dialog.

* gh-69365: As caixas de diálogo de pesquisa do IDLE agora exibem um
  erro de expressão regular abaixo do campo de entrada, em vez de em
  uma caixa de mensagem.

* gh-105689: Corrige as dicas de chamada (calltips), a correspondência
  de parênteses e a indentação automática no Console IDLE após a
  exibição de uma saída contendo aspas ou parênteses desbalanceados.

* gh-60402: No IDLE, pressionar Tab em uma string que não esteja no
  início de um nome de arquivo insere uma tabulação em vez de abrir a
  lista de preenchimento automático.

* gh-68453: Corrigida a execução do IDLE com a opção -s em conjunto
  com -c, -r ou -: o comando ou script agora é executado após o
  arquivo de inicialização, sem exibir uma caixa de diálogo de erro e
  sem reiniciar o console.

* gh-69919: IDLE now reports any exception raised by compiling the
  source, such as "MemoryError" for too deeply nested source, instead
  of hanging the Shell.

* gh-91398: Remove the border around the IDLE Shell sidebar, which was
  drawn in the window background color and stood out with dark themes.

* gh-71136: Fix a hang of the IDLE Shell when code run under the
  debugger raises "KeyboardInterrupt".

* gh-154511: Consolida o tratamento da roda do mouse do IDLE em
  "idlelib.util". A função "wheel_event" é transferida de
  "idlelib.tree" para lá e junta-se a "x11_buttons" — que indica se o
  Tk reporta rotações da roda a um widget como eventos
  "<Button-4>"/"<Button-5>" — e a "bind_wheel", que associa os eventos
  enviados pelo Tk.

* gh-156896: Para de excluir submódulos do tkinter quando idlelib.run
  for importado.

* gh-153480: Fix IDLE failing to start when opening a file which does
  not exist yet. Fix a traceback when a file open in the IDLE editor
  is deleted by another program; IDLE now asks whether to close the
  window, save the file elsewhere, or ignore it.

* gh-66172: O IDLE não falha mais ao iniciar quando um arquivo de
  configuração do usuário está corrompido. O arquivo ilegível é
  renomeado com o sufixo ".bad", as configurações padrão são
  utilizadas em seu lugar e um aviso lista os arquivos afetados.

* gh-90304: Impede que o IDLE falhe ao iniciar quando uma fonte relata
  largura zero para o caractere "'0'". Esse tipo de fonte defeituosa
  causava um "ZeroDivisionError"; agora, o editor utiliza a largura
  configurada como alternativa.

* gh-135511: Fix display of "NameError" and "AttributeError" with
  multi-line message.


Ferramentas/Demos
-----------------

* gh-158451: "python-gdb.py" is now able to format an invalid Unicode
  string: render invalid characters as "\Uhhhhhhhh" instead of raising
  an exception. Patch by Victor Stinner.

* gh-156219: Fix Argument Clinic generating code which reads an
  optional positional argument which was not passed, if the function
  has a "**kwds" parameter.

* gh-113318: Correção na Clínica de Argumentos para "@getter" e
  "@setter" dentro de um bloco condicional de pré-processador;
  anteriormente, ocorria um erro interno. A Clínica de Argumentos
  agora também rejeita acessores de um mesmo atributo que possuam
  nomes base em C diferentes, bem como o mesmo acessor definido duas
  vezes — situações que, silenciosamente, geravam entradas inválidas
  ou duplicadas de "PyGetSetDef".

* gh-155218: Fix Argument Clinic generating the flags of the optional
  groups in different order on 32-bit and 64-bit platforms.

* gh-155207: Argument Clinic now supports the "--dry-run" and "--diff"
  options. They list the files which would be changed, or write a
  unified diff of the changes to the standard output, without
  modifying any file.

* gh-64502: Fix Argument Clinic support of parameters with a default
  value used together with optional groups. Such parameters were
  always required in the generated parsing code.


API C
-----

* gh-159739: Fix a crash in "_PyTuple_Resize()" when resizing a non-
  empty tuple to a negative or too large size. It now raises
  "SystemError" or "MemoryError" respectively.

* gh-159739: "PyInitConfig_SetStr()" now releases a previously
  configured value and preserves it if conversion of the replacement
  fails.

* gh-159739: Fix a reference leak when "_PyTuple_Resize()" fails.

* gh-149044: Fix the "PySlot_END" macro for C++: initialize all
  members to avoid compiler warnings. Patch by Victor Stinner.

* gh-158810: Fix "Py_ARRAY_LENGTH()" macro on C++: do not use
  "__builtin_types_compatible_p()" on C++. Patch by Victor Stinner.

* gh-158451: Fix "_PyUnicodeWriter_WriteLatin1String()" when the
  writer buffer kind is UCS-2 or UCS-4. Patch by Victor Stinner.

* gh-157649: Fix "Py_CLEAR" and "Py_SETREF" macros on C++: implement
  them using "auto" instead of "decltype()". Using "decltype()"
  produced invalid code when clearing/setting an array item. Patch by
  Victor Stinner.

* gh-142217: Add tests on the undocumented and deprecated
  "_Py_Identifier" C API. Patch by Victor Stinner.

* gh-157384: "PyImport_CreateModuleFromInitfunc()" now sets the
  package context while calling *initfunc*, so that a single-phase
  init submodule created with only the last component of its name gets
  the full name from the spec.

* gh-157242: Fix "PyBytesWriter_Resize()" to handle properly memory
  allocation failure. Leave the writer unchanged on error, instead of
  leaving it in an inconsistent state. Patch by Victor Stinner.

* gh-156101: Don't set the result in error in "PyLong_AsInt32()",
  "PyLong_AsUInt32()", "PyLong_AsInt64()" and "PyLong_AsUInt64()".
  Leave the result unchanged in this case. Patch by Victor Stinner.


Python 3.15.0 final
===================

*Data de lançamento: 2026-10-09*

Não houve novas alterações na versão 3.15.0.


Python 3.15.0 candidato a lançamento 3
======================================

*Data de lançamento: 2026-10-02*


Segurança
---------

* gh-158446: Corrige uma falha ou saída incorreta que poderia ocorrer
  ao formatar um "float" ou "complex" com uma precisão próxima ao
  "INT_MAX" da plataforma. A função "PyOS_double_to_string()" agora
  levanta uma "ValueError" para qualquer precisão dessa magnitude,
  independentemente do tipo de apresentação ou do valor, assim como os
  analisadores de string de formato já faziam para precisões acima de
  "INT_MAX".

* gh-156793: "asyncio": "loop.start_tls()" e
  "loop.create_connection()" agora valida o argumento
  *server_hostname* se um "ssl.SSLContext" for passado com
  *check_hostname* definido com "True".

* gh-156793: "ssl.SSLContext.wrap_bio()" agora valida seus argumentos
  *server_side*, *server_hostname* e *session* similares a
  "ssl.SSLContext.wrap_socket()".

  Em particular, um contexto com "check_hostname" habilitado e sem que
  um *server_hostname* seja passado para "wrap_bio()" agora levanta
  uma "ValueError" em vez de concluir um handshake que verificava a
  cadeia de certificados sem verificar a identidade da outra parte,
  sem qualquer indicação de que a verificação havia sido ignorada.

* gh-157265: Em "tarfile", quando a extração de um link recorre à
  extração de um membro do arquivo, o membro deve ser ignorado se a
  função de filtro retornar None ao ser chamada com o nome do membro
  extraído substituído pelo nome do link.

* gh-157953: Atualiza o libexpat empacotado para a versão 2.8.5.

* gh-157579: Corrige uma condição de corrida na limpeza de
  "tempfile.TemporaryDirectory". Ao contornar erros de permissão do
  sistema de arquivos, os arquivos agora são removidos com base em
  descritores de arquivo de diretórios abertos, em vez de resolver
  novamente seus caminhos; assim, a substituição de um diretório da
  árvore por um link simbólico não pode mais fazer com que a limpeza
  exclua arquivos fora do diretório temporário. Isso soluciona a **CVE
  2026-12345**.

* gh-156293: Corrige uma falha no "ssl" que ocorria quando um
  "sni_callback" alternava uma conexão para outro "SSLContext" e o
  contexto que continha a função de retorno deixava de ser
  referenciado pela aplicação. Servidores que mantêm ativo o contexto
  do seu "sni_callback" (o caso habitual, quando ele encapsula o
  *socket* de escuta ou está armazenado no objeto do servidor) não
  foram afetados. Isso soluciona a **CVE 2026-19445**.


Núcleo e embutidos
------------------

* gh-158140: Resolve submódulos irmãos importados de forma preguiçosa
  (lazy) e de maneira independente, de modo que acessar um não importe
  outro apenas porque sua declaração apareceu por último.

* gh-158364: Corrige uma falha que ocorria quando
  "sys._current_frames()" ou "sys._current_exceptions()" eram chamados
  enquanto outro interpretador estava em execução.

* gh-158254: Iteradores reversos sobre um "dict" e suas visualizações
  agora levantam "RuntimeError" se as chaves do dicionário forem
  alteradas durante a iteração — assim como os iteradores diretos —,
  em vez de fornecerem entradas para as novas chaves.

* gh-157914: Reverte gh-146064. A alteração relacionada ao PyMutex
  estava causando uma regressão significativa de desempenho em alguns
  casos.

* gh-157838: Mescle contagens de referências enviesadas em nome de
  threads desvinculadas (detached) em vez de aguardar que elas se
  vinculem novamente, na construção com threads livres.

* gh-157778: Inclui o número da linha da chave de abertura na
  "SyntaxError" para um campo de substituição de f-string ou t-string
  não fechado, quando uma aspa correspondente em uma linha posterior
  for interpretada como o início de uma string não terminada.

* gh-157757: Corrige um "import a.b as c" preguiçoso que lia "b" a
  partir de "a" em vez de importar o módulo "a.b". Agora, ele associa
  o submódulo e levanta uma exceção "ModuleNotFoundError" quando não
  há um módulo correspondente ao nome.

* gh-155695: Nomes resolvidos agora são removidos de
  "sys.lazy_modules" de forma mais consistente: uma importação
  preguiçosa (*lazy import*) de um módulo já carregado não é mais
  registrada, e a materialização de "lazy from pkg import attr" agora
  descarta a entrada "pkg.attr".

* gh-157378: Corrige "SyntaxError.offset" e "SyntaxError.end_offset"
  para o erro "Non-UTF-8 code starting with ..." quando um caractere
  não ASCII precede o byte inválido na mesma linha. Patch por Shamil
  Abdulaev.

* gh-156762: Correção de comportamento indefinido em
  "operator.methodcaller": a função do slot "tp_clear" retornava
  "void" em vez de "int", fazendo com que o coletor de lixo a chamasse
  por meio de um tipo de função incompatível. Patch por Shamil
  Abdulaev.

* gh-157377: Corrige "gc.get_count()" na construção com threads
  livres: a função estava reiniciando o contador de alocação local da
  thread que agenda a coleta de lixo automática. Uma thread que a
  chamasse durante uma alocação poderia impedir que lixo cíclico fosse
  coletado.

* gh-157247: Corrige "sys.activate_stack_trampoline()" permitindo a
  ativação a partir de um subinterpretador enquanto o JIT está
  habilitado no interpretador principal.

* gh-156995: Corrigido o problema em que um "bytearray" compartilhava
  seu buffer com um objeto "bytes" de um único byte e de mesmo valor,
  fazendo com que a escrita no bytearray modificasse aquele objeto
  "bytes". Isso ocorria com "bytearray.take_bytes()" quando restava
  exatamente um byte e, na construção com threads livres, quando um
  bytearray era reduzido para um único byte a partir de outra thread.

* gh-156910: Corrige um impasse na construção com *threads livres* ao
  definir "__abstractmethods__" em um tipo enquanto outra thread detém
  a trava do tipo.

* gh-156894: Corrige a posição de erros de sintaxe que abrangem um
  intervalo, caso a linha contenha caracteres não ASCII antes do erro.

* gh-155525: Corrige a tokenização de tempo quadrático de módulos que
  contêm muitas f-strings ou t-strings.

* gh-156689: Corrige uma leitura fora dos limites em "compile()" e
  "ast.parse()" quando um objeto AST é passado com "mode='func_type'".

* gh-156114: Corrige uma falha no *trampoline* do perf quando um
  objeto código possui um nome ou nome de arquivo que não pode ser
  codificado em UTF-8. Correção feita por Shamil Abdulaev.

* gh-156126: Corrige uma falha ao importar um módulo cujo nome contém
  caracteres que não podem ser codificados em UTF-8 (como *surrogates*
  isolados) enquanto "-X importtime" está habilitado.

* gh-155526: Corrige um "OverflowError" espúrio para "abs(nanj)" caso
  "errno" tenha sido definido anteriormente como "ERANGE" por alguma
  chamada de biblioteca. Patch por Sergey B Kirpichev.

* gh-151464: Exclui o token inválido "<>" da saída de "tokenize".
  "SyntaxError" para "<>" agora sugere "!=".

* gh-154719: Espaços em branco ao final de uma expressão de
  interpolação em *t-string* agora são preservados em
  "string.templatelib.Interpolation.expression", até o "}" de
  fechamento ou até o delimitador de conversão ("!"), formatação (":")
  ou depuração ("="). Continuações de linha explícitas após um "=" de
  depuração permanecem como parte do texto de depuração e são
  excluídas de "expression".

* gh-152708: Corrige a assimetria na geração da AST em que o operador
  unário positivo "+" era implicitamente descartado em expressões de
  correspondência de padrões, restaurando a paridade de análise
  sintática com o operador unário negativo "-".


Biblioteca
----------

* gh-157788: Corrige a falha do comando "python -m asyncio ps" ao
  lidar com um processo que possui uma tarefa com nome superior a 255
  caracteres.

* gh-157660: Corrige "profiling.sampling" relatando erros ou números
  de linha incorretos em construções com threads livres quando um
  array de bytecode local à thread aumenta de tamanho ou recebe novas
  entradas após ter sido armazenado em cache.

* gh-157639: Corrige uma falha no "cProfile" quando um temporizador
  externo reentra no perfilador. Eventos de perfilamento levantados
  enquanto o temporizador externo está em execução agora são
  ignorados.

* gh-157335: Corrige uma escrita fora dos limites em
  "mmap.mmap.__setitem__" que poderia ocorrer quando a conversão do
  índice ou do valor atribuído (via "__index__()" para um único item,
  ou via protocolo de buffer para uma fatia) redimensionasse ou
  fechasse o objeto mmap durante a atribuição.

* gh-128509: "marshal.load()" e "marshal.loads()" agora podem obter
  singletons de strings de 1 byte. Patch por Victor Stinner.

* gh-157301: Corrige "asyncio.Task" travando o laço de eventos quando
  uma inicialização imediata (*eager start*) falha ao entrar no
  contexto da tarefa.

* gh-157213: Corrige o problema em que "asyncio.gather()" deixava
  arestas obsoletas no grafo de *await* em tarefas filhas que
  persistiam após a conclusão da função.

* gh-156002: O módulo "zipfile" volta a ler membros por meio de um
  descompressor de terceiros instalado via alteração dinâmica (monkey-
  patching) do método privado "_get_decompressor()" para retornar um
  objeto que implementa apenas a antiga API do BZ2Decompressor do
  Python 3.3. Note que descompressores que não possuem o atributo
  "needs_input" e um método "decompress()" que aceite dois argumentos
  são vulneráveis à **CVE 2026-15310**.

* gh-157159: A mensagem de uso exibida por "python -m tabnanny" quando
  nenhum argumento é fornecido agora sugere "python -m" em vez do
  arquivo-fonte.

* gh-157058: "asyncio.wait_for()" com um tempo limite não positivo
  agora registra o *waiter* no grafo de chamadas.

* gh-156933: Corrige valores de retorno inteiros incorretos de funções
  de retorno do "ctypes" em algumas plataformas, como s390x.

* gh-156988: "asyncio.print_call_graph()" não mais trunca a pilha de
  chamadas no gerador síncrono.

* gh-156970: Define a docstring de "unittest.mock.Mock.return_value".

* gh-156924: "annotationlib.ForwardRef.evaluate()" agora resolve
  proxies de importação preguiçosa (*lazy import*) encontrados no
  espaço de nomes. Com "FORWARDREF", uma importação preguiçosa que
  falha ao ser resolvida agora resulta em um "ForwardRef" em vez do
  "proxy de importação preguiçosa", e com "VALUE", a exceção
  subjacente é propagada.

* gh-127057: Corrige transportes UDP de "asyncio.ProactorEventLoop" de
  forma que uma "ConnectionResetError" levantada por "WSARecvFrom"
  deixe de interromper o laço de leitura.

* gh-156512: Corrige "asyncio" perdendo uma conexão duas vezes quando
  "resume_writing()" fecha o transporte.

* gh-155596: Correção para "pprint.pprint()" e "pprint.pformat()" com
  "expand=True", que não respeitavam o parâmetro *width* para valores
  aninhados. A largura do prefixo "'key':" não era contabilizada ao
  determinar se um valor cabia na linha atual; assim, valores
  associados a chaves longas podiam exceder o limite de *width* em vez
  de serem expandidos.

* gh-155433: Corrige a perda de cancelamento externo por
  "asyncio.TaskGroup" após "cancel()".

* gh-155418: Corrige o travamento de "asyncio.TaskGroup" quando uma
  tarefa criada por "asyncio.eager_task_factory()" cancela o grupo
  antes de ser suspendido.

* gh-155143: Corrige o vazamento da tarefa chamadora em
  "asyncio.shield()" — via grafo de *await* e funções de retorno —
  quando a função é chamada em um *future* que nunca é resolvido.

* gh-154470: Corrigido um "^J" espúrio impresso ao final de cada linha
  de código-fonte pelo comando "list" do "pdb" quando a saída está
  colorida (por exemplo, ao anexar a um processo em execução). A linha
  de código-fonte agora é limpa antes de ser colorida, assim como o
  comando "where" já fazia.

* gh-154335: O perfilador "profiling.sampling" agora respeita
  "NO_COLOR", "FORCE_COLOR" e "PYTHON_COLORS", e evita saídas
  coloridas quando não está escrevendo em um terminal.

* gh-154090: Registra o modo de perfilamento nos perfis binários do
  Tachyon e rejeite comparações diferenciais cujos modos conhecidos
  não correspondem.

* gh-152907: Restaura os sinalizadores de saída do terminal em modo
  "cooked" ao redor das funções de chamada de "PyOS_InputHook" no novo
  *REPL* ("_pyrepl"), de modo que a saída escrita por um gancho de
  entrada (por exemplo, um laço de eventos de um toolkit de GUI) não
  seja mais emitida com "OPOST" desabilitado e preserve seus
  caracteres de retorno de carro (*carriage returns*).

* gh-151179: Corrige um vazamento de *pidfd* em "_PidfdChildWatcher"
  no Linux: o observador não vaza mais o descritor de arquivo do
  processo quando "waitpid()" falha com um erro diferente de
  "ChildProcessError".


Documentação
------------

* gh-57491: Reduz a profundidade do sumário na documentação EPUB de
